narrative.intro: SLS Federal Services has $2.4B in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. SLS Federal Services’ obligations in this dataset are concentrated in FY2026 to date, so the $2.4B figure reflects partial-year activity rather than a full fiscal-year total. SLS Federal Services’ small award count combined with a high average award size indicates that a few large awards drive the reported obligations. SLS Federal Services’ profile in this dataset is useful for readers who track vendor concentration, award-size distribution, and year-to-date obligations, and for comparisons where partial-year totals are relevant.
